review_scope.text_review: Exhaustive across main and remediation blocks, including nested visuals, alt text, code annotations, media summary and bridges, recaps and next-tile previews. Lesson titles and summaries also reviewed.
review_scope.sampling_method: Every third interaction in tile/step order, starting with the first (36 percent). Reviewed sampled prompts, options/items/tasks, feedback and hints.

boundary_assessments.finding: Operator checks, subnet allocation and route selection stay within their respective glossary teaching. External IP/CIDR preparation is explicitly assumed by the glossary, not a blocked later concept. The routing caveat that a default route does not prove connectivity does not require security-group or connectivity-diagnosis knowledge.

Container ownership and EC2/RDS service boundaries are taught in these concepts themselves. Learners need not operate pods, tasks, instances or databases, select a compute implementation, or perform patching. The RDS parameter-group definition is an explicit current-concept required fact, not dependence on the later database-operation lesson.

Supplied restoration/data-loss durations, surviving capacities and ownership/checklist conditions allow direct application of the current teaching. No restoration implementation, autoscaling policy, controlled failure procedure or runbook execution must be understood.

The sampled IAM exercise supplies wildcard-resource and StringEquals matching rules and tag values. These are inputs to current identity-policy evaluation; understanding tag-based cost attribution, S3 operation, resource-based permissions or later IAM troubleshooting is unnecessary.

Workflow commands and Java/Gradle application are supplied examples rather than required independent build logic. DORA interpretation needs no later workflow-improvement procedure. EventBridge samples require field/value matching and test-result interpretation only, not target authorization or delivery handling.
Next-tile titles are passing previews. They do not make future concepts prerequisites for following the current lesson.

summary: No reviewed content requires understanding a concept in its tile's blocked_future_concepts. No leakage defects identified. Interaction conclusion is limited to the declared sample; all text blocks were reviewed. Deterministic gates were not rerun, and generator reasoning or review claims were not consulted.
